name: Within Health
one_liner: Within Health runs intensive virtual eating disorder treatment (partial hospitalization and IOP) at home, for ages 13 and up, mostly via insurance.
best_for: Teens (13+) and adults with an eating disorder who need more than weekly therapy but not 24/7 care
People stepping down from residential or inpatient eating disorder treatment
People without a specialist eating disorder program nearby whose insurance covers Within
not_for: Anyone in crisis or medically unstable: call 911, or call or text 988
People who need 24/7 residential or inpatient care or in-person medical care
People who can't commit at least 9 hours a week to treatment
short_description: Intensive virtual eating disorder care (PHP and IOP, 9+ hours/week) for ages 13+, with meal support and medical monitoring. Mostly via insurance.
long_description: Within Health is a US virtual eating disorder treatment provider offering a partial hospitalization program and an intensive outpatient program, both delivered at home by video. These are high levels of care: the IOP is at least 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, and the PHP is longer, so it is a big time commitment. Care includes individual, group and family therapy, supported meals, nutrition counselling, psychiatry and medical monitoring, for anorexia, bulimia, binge eating disorder, ARFID and related conditions, for people 13 and older. A 2026 review said it operates in 40 states and DC; it does not offer inpatient or residential care. Within accepts many insurance plans and offers payment plans or financing, but does not publish self-pay prices. It is a HIPAA covered provider. Within's clinicians have published case reports and contributed studies to reviews of remote eating disorder care, but we did not find a published outcomes study of its own program.

pricing.starting_price: Insurance (many plans accepted); payment plans or financing if not covered
pricing.notes: No self-pay price is published; Within's team checks benefits and discusses financing. Cost depends on your plan's coverage for PHP or IOP.

privacy.notes: Website policy (read 2026-10-27) says Within does not 'sell' data under the CCPA, but shares data with service providers for marketing and uses cookies and web beacons to personalize marketing without saying whether that includes targeted ads; deletion is described only as a California right.

faqs.q: What level of care does Within Health provide?
faqs.a: Within provides virtual intensive outpatient (IOP) and outpatient levels of care. IOP typically involves 9-15+ hours per week of treatment—multiple group sessions, individual therapy, and meal support. This is more intensive than weekly therapy but flexible for daily life.

Yes, Within accepts most major insurance plans for eating disorder treatment. They handle insurance verification and prior authorization. Contact them to confirm your specific coverage before enrolling.

faqs.q: What's included in Within Health treatment?
faqs.a: Treatment includes medical monitoring, psychiatric evaluation and medication management, individual therapy, multiple weekly groups, family therapy, meal observation and support, and nutrition counseling. Your treatment team coordinates comprehensive care.

faqs.q: Is virtual IOP effective for eating disorders?
faqs.a: Research shows virtual eating disorder treatment can be effective at the IOP level, especially when it includes medical monitoring and meal support. Within's approach mirrors the components of in-person IOP programs. Outcomes are tracked to ensure progress.

primary_uses: Virtual partial hospitalization for eating disorders
Medical and psychiatric monitoring at home

availability.note: US only, about 40 states and DC (2026 review); ages 13+. Virtual PHP and IOP only, no inpatient or residential care.

patient_summary: This is intensive treatment, not weekly therapy: in the IOP you join therapy, groups and supported meals by video at least 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, and the partial hospitalization program is more. A team of therapists, dietitians, doctors and psychiatrists works with you, with medical monitoring from home. You start with an assessment call; Within bills many insurance plans and offers payment plans if you're not covered.
